text:
Situation: Olanzapine 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current on-hand supply across Corvale sites ranges from 11.7 to 28.8 days. Corvale Lakeside holds only 15 tablets (11.7 days), creating a near-term gap.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include olanzapine as of 2026-10-21. A registered plant for olanzapine, Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3007517881), received OAI classifications after inspections ending 2017-11-24 and 2021-11-01, and a VAI classification after an inspection ending 2023-10-20. Three recalls from this manufacturer are recorded: a Class II recall initiated 2022-02-16 for cGMP deviations, a Class II recall initiated 2024-11-25 for failed impurity specifications on 2.5 mg tablets, and a Class III recall initiated 2026-08-27 for failed impurity specifications on 5 mg tablets.

Our position: Supply is adequate at two sites but critically low at Corvale Lakeside. No national shortage exists, but the manufacturer's inspection and recall history warrants proactive sourcing from alternate suppliers not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate orders for olanzapine 10 mg tablets from Alkermes, Inc. (not on FDA shortage list); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently stocked.
2. Buyer to qualify Apotex Corp., Ascend Laboratories, LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and Bionpharma Inc. as backup sources (none on FDA shortage list); requires P&T committee approval for each new supplier.
3. Buyer to allocate existing stock to Corvale Lakeside within 48 hours; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes at next P&T meeting; requires buyer action only.

Not recommended: Switching patients to alternative agents or changing dosing regimens; clinical decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
